name: region-0.csv.gz
query:
SELECT FLOOR(l / 0.1) AS lon_bin, FLOOR((b + 90.0) / 0.1) AS lat_bin, COUNT(*) AS source_count,
SUM(POWER(10.0, -0.4 * (phot_g_mean_mag - 7.5))) AS relative_flux
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE l >= 0 AND l < 60
AND b >= -20 AND b <= 20
AND phot_g_mean_mag > 7.5 AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 17
GROUP BY lon_bin, lat_bin
